The '''L-41C weapon power converter''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engine component produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The converter allowed [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to transfer of the ship's engine power to the weapon reserves, enabling the ship to fire its weapons for a longer sustained period.
